correctness.rationale: Polynomial coefficient recurrence follows directly from formal logarithmic differentiation. Exact rational coefficients through n=14 establish margins at least 3 at k=6; each higher power of 2 increases the margin, proving uniform normalized odd units for all odd u. The Legendre forbidden-shape criterion and an explicit fourteen-index residue check give the eight cases and sharp bound. The five low-power exceptions and the sharp threshold witness at 96 are exhaustively verified from the independent integer recurrence. The package includes the complete executable rational/integer certificate.

value.rationale: The first non-three-square index is a natural sharp cutoff for the general colored binary partition representation problem. This theorem gives a complete infinitely-parameterized eight-class classification for every color count divisible by 64, shows the exact global bound 14 is attained, demonstrates the threshold six is necessary, and covers all positive-exponent powers of two including low-valuation exceptions. The coefficient-polynomial linearization supplies an explanatory mechanism rather than unrelated finite tabulation.
